newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian electric connector maker intends listing.
newsitem.headline: Italian electric connector maker intends listing.

text.p: Italian company Cembre, which manufactures connectors for electric currents, is seeking listing on the Milan stock market between mid-July and mid-September, the company said.
Cembre, which is based in the northern town of Brescia, intends to float 25-30 percent of the company on the market by offering four to six million new shares to the public.
The offer price range is expected to be between 5,000 to 7,500 lire per share.

Cembre, which was founded in 1969 and is 94 percent controlled by the Rosani family, had sales of 55.6 billion lire in 1996, of which around one third were in exports mostly to Europe. It made a net profit of 4.2 billion lire.
Its remaining six percent stake is controlled by managers.
